The '''Lakkari Tar Pits''' are located in the northcentral are of [[Un'Goro Crater]], just south of [[Marshal's Refuge]] and north of [[Fire Plume Ridge]]. Giant bones and [[Tar Beast]]s can be found surrounding the pools.
